summary: Adds a versioned LFRT local-runtime observation path and an opt-in RG-2 admission authority with tri-state applicability, stale-capacity invalidation, fail-closed managed unknowns, legacy shadow veto, and delayed-transport generation revalidation; default and current production authority remain legacy.

components.owning_subsystem: RG-2 local-runtime fact observation, capacity admission, startup configuration, and mechanical architecture observability
components.disposition: ADMIT as opt-in mechanical resource authority. LFRT owns positive local capacity only when explicitly selected; managed unknown/conflict fails before transport; legacy remains the default and is shadow-veto-only in LFRT mode. No semantic task ranking or model completion authority is added.
evidence: Formal-main audit proved observer-unknown could otherwise yield no lease, stale capacity had no invalidation path, and generic unknown acquisition could wait indefinitely.

g1.necessity: A local runtime capacity source cannot become admission authority while observation failure silently bypasses RG-2, stale limits survive failed observations, or delayed Learning transport can cross runtime generations. The new machinery closes those mechanical gaps before any production cutover.

g2.authority_owner: ProviderCallCoordinator + ResourceGovernor using the explicitly selected LFRT runtime-observation/v1 fact source
g2.non_duplication: The selector is exclusive: LFRT is the sole positive capacity authority in lfrt mode, while the legacy adapter is shadow-veto-only and never fallback capacity. The existing Governor/Coordinator remain the admission owners; no second scheduler or semantic policy engine is introduced.

model_evidence: typed local_runtime admission-authority mode in runtime status
LFRT observation source_ref and PID generation attached to the installed capacity fact
ResourceAdmissionError reason codes required_fact_unknown/fact_conflict before provider transport
on-demand local_runtime diagnostic snapshot and independent legacy/LFRT parity evidence
g3.recovery_or_reason: Repair or restore the machine-observation facts, or explicitly select legacy admission authority and restart the LFL service. Managed-local unknown never uses an implicit fallback capacity; active leases remain non-preemptive and future admission waits for a new valid fact.

g4.rollback: Set `local_runtime.admission_authority=legacy` (the default) and restart Web/Feishu through the existing dual-root process path. 8901 itself need not restart and no persistent application-data migration is involved.
